findings.title: Missing await on async fetch_rate call
findings.body: `fetch_rate` is an async function, but it is called without `await`, so the coroutine object is returned instead of the rate. This will raise a `TypeError` when the multiplication is attempted. Add `await` before `fetch_rate(pair)`.

findings.title: Potential loss of precision in currency conversion
findings.body: The function multiplies `amount_cents` (an integer) by `rate` (a `Decimal`) and rounds the result to an integer. If `rate` is not a whole number, this can lead to rounding errors that accumulate over multiple conversions. Consider using `Decimal` for the result type and rounding explicitly with a precision context.

summary.problem: The new async currency conversion function lacks an await and risks precision loss.
summary.done_well: The function is clearly documented and uses a dedicated rate-fetching helper.
